title: Day Counter by Niruki
description: Adds a small pixel-art calendar at the top-left of your screen showing the current day of your world. Fully customizable color, size, and position.
body:
Day Counter
Ever lost track of how long you've been playing your world? Day Counter shows your current Minecraft day in a tiny pixel-art calendar at the top-left of your screen — styled like a real wall calendar with a spiral binding and a colored header.

Features

Wall-calendar design — 
colored header, white page, and little spiral binding rings on top

Live day counter — 
reads the current day directly from your world, no setup required

9 color themes — 
green (default), red, yellow, blue, purple, pink, orange, dark green, turquoise

Adjustable size — 
scale from 0.5× to 6× to match your UI

Repositionable — 
move the overlay to any pixel offset from the top-left corner

Toggle the header & text shadow — 
fine-tune the look

Persistent settings — 
saved to config/daycounter-client.toml, survives restarts
